item.description: Hippkles #9663 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (the stone in their midst (House of Chthonius)). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown. Hippkles has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.description: Astippos #3645 and Neoope #4936 fought in the Field of Ares. Both limp now; neither will forget. Astippos is the cruel now.
